data.title: Dei Ex Machina Event Pass: Unleash Your Power ‘til October 13
data.summary: Discover the gods in the machine.
data.meta_title: Dei Ex Machina Event Pass: Unleash Your Power ‘til October 13
data.content:
A new era of engineering innovation has begun. The Terminus Blockade is over, and trade goods have started to flow into Tortuga, much to the relief of the Pilots. The time to construct formidable War Robots is nigh, and bombastic battles aren’t too far behind. 

Unleash the power of the Dei Ex Machina Event Pass now until October 13. 

Dei Ex Machina Event Pass: Free & Premium Rewards

Unlock four Shipments starting on September 9 to unleash the power of the War Robots Ceres and Anansi, start a scene with additional Weapons and Gear, and step into battle with a fresh new fit with Animated Wraps and new Stickers. 

  • Anansi (War Robot): Unweave enemy strategies with Anansi, the Tactician-class spider War Robot. Anansi boasts high maneuverability, letting it quickly seize the high ground before homing in on targets from afar. Spin up a Camouflage Web (Core Gear) to render allies within the radius invisible to enemies, allowing for tactical pushes or retreats.
  • Ceres (War Robot): Ceres is a Defender-class War Robot, designed for support, protection, and engineered with repair tech to keep allies in the fight. Stay close to allies and activate Rejuvenator (Core Gear) to repair Ceres’ armor, and give allies in range armor regeneration and a doubled repair rate.

  • MLx2: Equip this Heavy Rocket Launcher, lock onto targets, and launch a hail of missiles.
  • Bisector: Lock, load, and fire vertical plasma projectiles to slice through everything in your path. Maximum efficiency guaranteed at close range.
  • Reflector (Cycle Gear): Returns a percentage of incoming damage back at the enemy for a short period.
  • Suppressor (Supply Gear): Throw a sticky grenade that reduces nearby enemy damage.
  • Flashbang (Cycle Gear): Fire a homing projectile that blinds enemies and deals damage.
  • Ghost Turret (Supply Gear): Deploy a turret that attacks the closest foe.

  • Stickers: Style it out with unique Stickers, including Fortified Heart, Mitosis, Angry Sprite, IV™, Monarch Eyes, and Freeconade™.
  • Animated Wraps: Light up the battlefield with Animated Wraps. Leave enemies green with envy with Emerald Blast, and rage like rocket fuel with Burning Engines. 

Animated Wraps 

As well as the Wraps available in the Dei Ex Machina Event Pass, you can also head to the Store to pick up even more stylish, dynamic skins to show off your signature style on the battlefield. 

  • Drakeplate: Imbue the spirit of a dragon with this amethyst-scaled Animated Wrap.
  • Molten Sands: Burn more than just rubber on the battlefield with this Desert-inspired Animated Wrap.
  • Raijin Strike: Hit hard with the power of lightning with the Raijin Strike Animated Wrap.

New Map: Battle for Horizon One

Test out Ceres and Anansi on a brand-new battlefield. Horizon One is a crash site turned proving ground that takes its name from the downed freighter ship at the map’s center. Horizon One possesses a large Noachium stock that every Dominion in the Wild Ten would die to obtain. 

Drop in to Horizon One in Warp Rush, Team Deathmatch, Last Robot Standing, and Spearhead Modes.

Team Deathmatch +: A New Way To Fight (September 9–16)

From September 9–16, load into Team Deathmatch + and boost your battles with a brand-new Power-Up! 

Pick up the randomly spawning Datacube for your team and watch your Victory Points skyrocket. Remember, knowledge is power. 

Note: The originalTeam Deathmatch Mode will still be available to play. 

Intel Discount Event (September 9–23)

From September 9–23, the Intel cost for upgrading Modules, Weapons, and Gear for Harpy, Ceres, Bulwark, and Matriarch will be reduced. 

Note: During the Intel Discount Event, deconstructing Modules will result in lower Intel returned.

Twitch Drops (September 9–23)

Earn Twitch Drops from September 9-23, including Salvage, Credits, Weapons, and more! Get all the info here.
